failure_conditions: Epistatic interactions among mutations dominate, so summed single/double-mutation effects mispredict higher-order variant activity and the source rank misleads acquisition.
Test variants carry mutations at positions never observed in the 0-2 mutation source set, leaving summed effects incomplete or undefined for key sites.
Distribution shift between low-order source and high-order test regime makes shrunk additive effects systematically biased.
The fixed decaying authority over-weights the source rank early, wasting scarce reveals (only 12) on additively-optimal but epistatically-poor variants.
parsed_hypothesis.hypothesis: Per-mutation activity effects estimated from 0-2 mutation source variants are approximately additive and, when summed, provide a useful prior ranking for >2 mutation target variants that improves best-so-far AUC over target-only GP-UCB.
parsed_hypothesis.mechanism: Fit shrunk additive per-mutation effects on completed source (train+validation) 0-2 mutation variants, sum the available component effects to score each higher-order test variant, and blend this source-derived rank with target-only GP-UCB under a fixed decaying authority that yields to target observations as reveals accumulate.
parsed_hypothesis.rationale: The source and target share the same IRED landscape and mutation vocabulary, and the source partition (0-2 mutations) is structurally the additive-decomposition regime needed to estimate per-mutation effects, so an additive prior is mechanistically coherent for seeding the low-data target search. The shrinkage plus fixed decaying authority bounds the damage from partial epistasis: the source only guides early acquisition and cedes control to target-only GP-UCB, which is safe under the strict evidence constraint that no test activities are visible to planner, gate, or selector. Given only 3 initial and 12 additional reveals, a defensible informative prior is more likely to help than pure target-only exploration, and the decay caps downside. This justifies the skill without inventing any observed performance.
parsed_hypothesis.transfer_scope: Transfer only shrunk additive per-mutation effect estimates from official train+validation 0-2 mutation source variants into a decaying-authority prior over rank for the two-to-many test partition (>2 mutations); transfer no absolute activity values and no target test observations.
